1.description: Fixed an issue where Arcanist's Explosion would prevent the use of Arcane Explosion.
Fixed an issue where Wave of Despair shared cooldown with Blast Wave.
[Pending Restart][Critical Prism] Critical Prism talent now makes your Ice Prism able to crit.

[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Corrupting Shadows did not work with Twilight Shock. It will now trigger even if Corruption is not learned and it can also trigger Jadefire Corruption if learned.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Hydromancer would not trigger the Electrocute incapacitate.
Corrupted Shiv will now apply Corruption, even if it's not learned. It can now also apply Jadefire Corruption if learned. (But only one Corruption spell at a time.)
Fixed an issue where Blades of Blood did not trigger. It will now also apply Rend, even if it's not learned.
Fixed an issue where Draining Strikes did not work.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Shimmer was not usable while casting.

[Pending Patch] [Pending Restart] [Elune] [Venomous Fury] Fixed an issue where rank 3 and onwards were not available at the correct levels; all ranks now match Ferocious Bite for when they're made available.
[Pending Patch] [Elune] [Water Nova] Updated the tooltip of Water Nova to reflect that it is now usable while Shapeshifted.
[Pending Patch] [Elune] [Razorlash] Updated Razorlash; it is now castable while shapeshifted into Cat and Bear forms.
[Pending Patch] [Elune] [Mass Razorlash] Is now usable in Bear form and will be made instant cast by Predatory Strikes.
[Pending Patch] [Elune] [Atal'ai Totem] Fixed an issue where the tooltip would not update the damage for each rank.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Compound Power] Fixed an issue where abilities cast in a close window could sometimes fail to award the correct number of combo points.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Sinister Transfusion] Fixed an issue where Sinister Transfusion could sometimes not apply to certain Tamed Beasts.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Energized Judgements] Fixed an issue where Energized Judgements could not trigger without having a 2-handed weapon equipped.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Rushed Judgement] Fixed an issue where Judgement of Fervor could not trigger Rushed Judgement.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Gurubashi Bloodsurge] Gurubashi Bloodsurge will now function correctly with regular Bloodsurge.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Traumatic Wounds] Fixed an issue where Claw could sometimes fail to refresh Rake.
[Pending Restart][Elune]Increased the healing of Draining Strikes by 300% and fixed an issue where it's internal cooldown was target based instead of proc based.
[Pending Restart][Elune]Increased the damage of Deathbringer by 300% and fixed an issue where it's internal cooldown was target based instead of proc based.
Fixed an issue where you couldn't Auto Shot while in Moonkin Form.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Dreading Despair will now trigger on 5 stacks even if you haven't learned Unstable Affliction.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where Locust Ranger did not always trigger Wild Quiver.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where Blood Hunting did not work.

0.description: [WeakAuras] Added a load option for In Manastorm
[Requires Restart] Increased Mark of Ascension gain from first time completion of Manastorm Levels by 50%.
Fixed an issue where some items were not scaling from Adventurer's Cache.
[Requires Restart] Added Tome of Lock Pick to Adventure mode rewards, so you can unlock this utility without spending AE.
Added a PvP mod that went missing from the Legacy of the Arcanist Proc. (0.42 pvp mod).
After prestiging, you now unlock all level 1 skillcards which can be used to basically freepick starters, see video.
Added Silas Darkmoon and Burth to the exits of every Start Zone to give you access to scrolls sooner and teach new players about scrolls of fortune.

7.description: [Pending Restart][Hasty Frost Shock] Increased cooldown reduction to 0.3 sec per Mystic Enchant. Up from 0.2.

5.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where scrolls of fortune displayed a tooltip that they all worked in spec I or IX when they were actually for Specs II, III, etc. To clarify [Scroll of Fortune II] will only work for Specialization II and [Scroll of Fortune III] for Specialization III and so on. This was merely a typo correction in tooltips, nothing changed in their interaction.

1.description: [Elune] Sunder Soul is now properly usable while shapeshifted.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Corrupted Shiv will now apply Corruption, even if not known.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Blades of Blood will now apply Rend, even if not known.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Holy Shatter did not work.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Pyroclasmic Ignition did not work.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Nightmare Mauling did not trigger Corruption and where it did not trigger its drain life effect.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Spreading Prism did not trigger.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Tainted Swipe would stop working and could trigger Infected Wounds.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Battering Ram did not apply Sunder Armor.
Fixed an issue where Echoed Incinerate had a 100% proc chance.
Fixed an issue where Arcane Arrows did not trigger from Frenzy Shot.
Fixed an issue where Barbed Snare Trap would show evade messages versus bosses.
Fixed an issue where Sunder Soul was not usable in Bear or Cat Form. (Pending Restart)
Fixed an issue where Spreading Tides would not spread Riptide. (Pending Restart)
Fixed an issue where Growing Corruption would not always apply Corruption. It will now apply Rank 1 if not known or your highest known rank. (Pending Restart)
Fixed an issue Syndicate Sniper Training did not trigger in PvP (requires restart)
Draconic Might now works with Feral Charge Cat and Bear.

0.description: Lowered cooldown of Manastorm Interrupting Rod to 15 Seconds from 30 Seconds.
Worldforged Rare Scrolls can now be vendored for 5 silver.

Added Layering to Stormwind and Orgrimmar to split up the growing population in those captials. You can change your layer on the Callboard. This is only active for those cities, not in the open world.
Fixed a bunch of quests that were missing their Adventure Caches. All Azeroth quests that are non-repeatable/daily with Kill or Loot requirements should have them now.
[Requires Restart] Totemic Focus now also grants you Crit and Haste rating for each totem you have active.
Removed Residual Monstrosity from Manastorm randomization, because this creature would knock you back 500 yards, SOMETIMES EVEN WHEN YOU WERE IN THE MANASTORM BUBBLE.
Reduced radius of pull from Manastorm Vortex affix by 50%.
Fixed an issue where Devastating Pound prevented the use of Devastate.
Added Scroll of Fortune and Talent Scroll of Fortune to Grumpus Daily.
Fixed a bug where Dark Apotheosis Immolation Aura had no defined spell scaling causing it to scale improperly. This bug fix comes with a 50% increase to its threat generation.

Added new ability that is learned automatically to Dark Apotheosis. Demon Claws consumes rage to attack with both weapons for damage. This is intended to help those who don't have a spammable in wildcard and provide extra incentive for Dual wield for those using physical in this form.
Added an additional 20 more Scroll of Fortune quests to Silas Darkmoon. 75 are now released and as of now 100 will be released by the end of week 1.
Fixed an issue where Heroic Dungeon Manastorm caches were not giving proper loot as Spirit Primary Stat
Improved group handling in Manastorm to prevent the group from being disband.
End-Game Manastorms now award Case of Fortune instead of Scrolls directly so you can open them in your preferred specialization.
Increased Scroll of Fortune Chance from Adventure Caches, High-Risk, and Callboard Caches.

[Requires Restart] Added Scrolls of Fortune and Sealed Card chance on Battleground Loss as a bad luck protection against lose streaks. Battleground Wins now give guaranteed Scroll of Fortune and Scroll of Fortune Talents
Fixed an issue where Adventure Mode characters could enter High-Risk and get quest credit from unscaled mobs on scaled quests.

Removed Critters from Manastorm randomization, because it would cause some creatures to become critters like the mobs in the BFD fire event, so you'd just have a critter sitting in the corner but you'd think the event was bugged, but really you just had to kill a bug.
Fixed Vendor costs on Skillcards available on vendors in the world being higher than intended.
Fixed a Mind Flay spell on Acolyte creatures that was dealing too much damage.
Reduced Physical Damage of Andre Firebeard in Max Level Manastorms
Improved Skillcard Drop Chances in the World.
Fixed cases where the Portal would fail to spawn at end of level in the Manastorm.
Fixed issues where your Raid group would be disbanded inside the Manastorm
Fixed many Spell Barrier spawns that could block your path in the Manastorm.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where Fel Meteor was not usable while shapeshifted.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue causing Mass Hysteria rank 2 and 3 to not fear multiple targets.

3.description: [Launcher] Fixed game version not being selected after updating launcher from ancient version.
[Launcher] Fixed download speed settings not saving.

5.description: Scrolls of Fortune are now deletable, you can delete them from the UI when you prestige (with the most recent launcher update) or out of your inventory by dragging them off the bag.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Trying to Auto Shot will no longer remove your shapeshift forms (and simply do nothing instead).
[Elune] Charge, Shadowstep, Intercept, Feral Charge, Intervene, Demon Charge, Battle Charge, Dragon Charge, Shadow Counter now share an 8 sec cooldown, changed from a full cooldown share.
[Elune] Wyvern Sting cooldown now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 40 sec.
[Elune] Psychic Horror now has a 60 sec cooldown, changed from 90 sec.
[Elune] Harvester of Death now reduces the cooldown of Death Coil by 5/10/15 sec, changed from 15/30/45 sec.
[Elune] Death Coil now has a 60 sec cooldown, changed from 120 sec.
[Elune] Blind now has a 90 sec cooldown, changed from 120 sec.
[Elune] Blinding Light now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 40 sec.
[Elune] Ring of Frost now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 40 sec.
[Elune] Petrification Totem now has a 25 sec cooldown, changed from 35 sec.
[Elune] Repentance now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 40 sec.
[Elune] Wyvern Sting now has a 30 sec cooldown, changed from 40 sec.
[Elune] Death Coil and Psychic Horror are now in the controlled stun DR category, changed from horror.

[Elune] Wyvern Sting, Repentance, Petrification Totem, Ring of Frost, Blinding Light and Blind are now in the global DR category, changed from horror. (They now share DR with for example Polymorph and Fear.)
Earthquake is now in the controlled stun DR category, changed from random stun.
Improved Hamstring is now in the controlled root DR category, changed from random root.
